title: Body Senses ABC
hook: Follow information farther than the surface.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D body-learning storybook, non-graphic anatomy models and everyday wellness cues, clean shapes; visual identity: Body Senses ABC

creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Body Senses ABC a sensory-pathway song: touch, taste, hearing, vision and voice are described as organ-plus-nerve-plus-brain processes, while digestive and dental targets remain honest comparison cards.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows information from outer structures toward neural processing without claiming one body spot equals one whole sense.
